The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Refuses to edit an applied migration and refuses fake unless the real schema is confirmed to match, explaining the migration table and schema would disagree
- Proposes restoring 0007 to its original content and adding a new corrective migration
- Suggests a CI check (makemigrations --check --dry-run) so a missing or conflicting migration fails early

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
